channel.title: The Equestrian Journal — Velvet & Valor
channel.description: Gift guides for horse lovers, equestrian lifestyle, and craft heritage from Velvet & Valor.

item.title: How to Care for Your Full-Grain Leather Case: A Complete Guide
item.description: Your Noble Steed Case is built to last a lifetime — but like all fine leather goods, it rewards a little attention. Kate Luthra walks you through everything you need to keep your case supple, protected, and looking impeccable for years to come.

item.title: Why We Source Leather from the Same Florentine Tannery
item.description: Kate Luthra on the decades-old relationship behind every Velvet & Valor case — and why provenance matters in luxury craft.

item.title: The Art of the Personalised Gift: Engraving at V&V
item.description: From initials to yard mottos — discover how our bespoke engraving service transforms a case into a keepsake worth passing down.

item.title: The Discerning Rider's Gift Guide for the Season
item.description: Whether you're shopping for a competition rider or a weekend hacker, our curated selection of gifts reflects the equestrian lifestyle at its finest.

item.title: 24K Gold Hardware: Why We Never Compromise on Fittings
item.description: The hardware on your Noble Steed Case isn't merely decorative. A closer look at how gold hardware outlasts the alternatives — and why it matters.

item.title: From the Tack Room to the Show Ring: A Day in the Life
item.description: We spent a morning at a yard in the Cotswolds with three of our customers — riders who carry their Noble Steed Cases from early hacks to evening stables.

item.title: Named for Those Who Ride First: The Story Behind Noble Steed
item.description: How a love of equestrian heritage and a frustration with generic accessories became the founding philosophy of Velvet & Valor's debut collection.
